evidence.quote: In this paper, we instead propose VoxelNext for fully sparse 3D object detection.
Our method achieves a better speed-accuracy trade-off than other mainframe detectors on the nuScenes dataset.
For the first time, we show that a fully sparse voxelbased representation works decently for LIDAR 3D object detection and tracking.

experiments.summary: Our method achieves a better speed-accuracy trade-off than other mainframe detectors on the nuScenes dataset. Extensive experiments on nuScenes, Waymo, and Argoverse2 benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our approach.
